systems.country_label: National Marriage Register System / National Marriage Registration System (marriages only)
systems.owner: URSB (Directorate of Civil Registration); function transferred to NIRA by the 2024 amendment Act
systems.tiers: 624 accounts at end FY2023/24, 13 of them new, held by Chief Administrative Officers in districts and by places of worship; civil marriages solemnised in Kampala; the report credits service automation and record digitisation
online; 6 regional offices, 2 Kampala branches and 44 TREP centres

systems.system: Security Interest in Movable Property Registry (SIMPO)

note: URSB's civil registration directorate handled marriages only (2,717 civil marriages in Kampala, 499 district returns, 1,538 customary registrations in FY2023/24); the report states nothing about births or deaths, which were never the bureau's. The marriage system is listed under civil as the registrar's own system, for marriages.
